Mocking helps achieve isolation by replacing real dependencies with fake (Mock) objects, so that our unit test do not use the real object.
OrderService "placeOrder(int amt)" invokes PaymentService "pay(int amt)" for placing the order.
So, when we write Unit test cases for OrderService "placeOrder" method, we should not invoke PaymentService or any other class, we need to MOCK (fake object) them.
So above, we mocked the call paymentService.pay(10).
instead of invoking the real method, we tell the test framework, "when this method is called, just return the predefined value without executing the actual logic."
As discussed in above 2 scenarios itself. Mocking isolates the unit under test by replacing real dependencies withfake objects (Mock obj)
